scope: independent studio personal and small-business project; no enterprise infrastructure or new paid accounts
sourceLaw: AI proposes. Policy authorizes. CI proves. Human promotes.

passes.name: identityAndAuthority
passes.evidence: GitHub repo eggie-admin/LuHm-OS is public; single human release authority; no worker role is autonomous without a process receipt.
passes.gate: Private keys and identity must remain outside GitHub/Android/public static pages.

passes.name: cloudflare
passes.evidence: doctrine/networkSpineV1.json tracks edge TLS and optional Tunnel. No Cloudflare control-plane access in connected tools.
passes.gate: Read DNS delegation, zone Full (strict), WAF/Access, Tunnel hostname and independent origin TLS validation before changes; never disable verification, expose .lan, or port forward.

passes.name: huggingFace
passes.evidence: OAuth user connection reported read-repos/read-mcp and jobs; no Pro subscription. No account settings mutation.
passes.gate: Use private repos for private models, pinned revisions, model-license and unsafe pickle review; no job run, publish or billing change without approval.

passes.name: render
passes.evidence: Nine configured services; eight web services reported public ingress 0.0.0.0/0 and empty healthCheckPath in API; checked-in render.yaml declares /healthz.
passes.gate: Probe live /healthz and actual MCP routing, separate public read-only endpoints from private control planes, verify allowed ingress and rollback before modifying live services.

passes.name: github
passes.evidence: Public GitHub source, existing PR workflows and typed SQL tests. Source ignore policy expanded for caches and local SQL; tracked secrets still require a separate review.
passes.gate: Minimize workflow permissions, pin third-party actions, constrain untrusted PR jobs and enforce branch review as available. Do not assume branch protection enforced.

passes.name: copilot
passes.evidence: Copilot bootstrap guards secrecy, least privilege, SQL boundaries, production writes and provider authorization.
passes.gate: Instruction file is advisory. Actual Copilot product entitlement and repository settings remain unverified.

passes.name: openAi
passes.evidence: Project Hydra plugin v1.0.1 exists as PRIVATE in account; current ChatGPT Plugin Management reports not installed.
passes.gate: No claiming host tool execution or published directory approval; verify installed host, per-tool auth/OAuth and server-side permissions before private reads or writes.

passes.name: sqlAuthority
passes.evidence: Disposable SQLite STRICT local stub with foreign keys and guarded authority fields. No Render Postgres instances found. Remote MariaDB not queried.
passes.gate: Prepared statements, least-privilege per-app identities, no remote SQL admin/public port, backup/snapshot before DDL; no production SQL mutation from CI.

passes.name: schemaAndAdversarialTests
passes.evidence: New direct SQL negative controls for sha, UTC, identity, finite floats, manifest authority, and injection text. PostgreSQL review-only schema parity.
passes.gate: Run tests/testTypedSqlStub.py and tests/testSqlHardeningTenPass.py in PR CI; exact source SHA required before claiming PASS.

passes.name: releaseAndRollback
passes.evidence: This change is source hardening only. No live provider bill, key rotation, Cloudflare mutation, Render deploy, plugin audience change or database migration.
passes.gate: Merge only after relevant green CI; report separately source green vs Render live vs browser checked vs private plugin installed vs SQL deployed.

costPolicy: Keep existing free-tier services unless explicit approved upgrade. Avoid extra always-on inference or duplicate providers.
sqlLane: SQLite STRICT local test; PostgreSQL review-only DDL, no active production DB evidenced
customerSafety: Public repo/site show only approved portfolio content, never donor archives, customer files, secrets or unapproved private models.
releaseAction: PR CI and review; no live-provider mutation until independently authenticated and scoped.
